title: External-crate constraint signal gaps: leading-:: imports, target-specific deps, workspace-dep renames, pubspec manifests
description:
Known bypass routes left open by bafae79 (external-crate constraints), all in constraints/external.rs:

1. **Leading `::` imports** — `use ::axum::Router;` yields an empty first segment in external_crate_of_import, returns None, escapes the import signal entirely. Fix: strip a leading "::" before splitting.

2. **`[target.'cfg(...)'.dependencies]`** — cargo_manifest_deps only reads dependencies / dev-dependencies / build-dependencies top-level tables. Platform-specific dep tables escape the manifest signal (import signal still catches uses, but a linked-never-imported dep is invisible).

3. **Workspace-level renames** — root `[workspace.dependencies] innocent = { package = "arrow-core" }` + member `innocent = { workspace = true }`: the member manifest only exposes "innocent", and code imports `use innocent::…`, so BOTH signals miss the real package. This fully bypasses the rename handling that manifest_check_rename_catches_real_package was written for. Fix: when scanning manifests, build a rename map from the root [workspace.dependencies] and resolve workspace=true entries through it.

4. **pubspec.yaml not checked** — Dart has the import signal only; README documents this as "not yet". Add pubspec.yaml dependency parsing for manifest-signal parity.

Found by vidhi-review of sutra/needs-designing/14. Item 3 matters most: it defeats the legally load-bearing AGPL-boundary use case the feature was designed for.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (diff 34dfdfc..2153533): **needs-attention**

3 findings:

1. **[high] Root Cargo.toml guard uses stale workspace rename map** (check.rs:686-698) — When checking a proposed root Cargo.toml edit, the rename map is read from disk (old content), not the proposed content. A root manifest edit that introduces `[workspace.dependencies] innocent = { package = "arrow-core" }` passes the guard because member manifests aren't re-checked with the proposed rename map.

2. **[high] Renamed crate imports still match only the alias** (external.rs:31-40) — Import signal strips to first path segment and matches literally. For `use innocent::...` with `innocent = { package = "arrow-core" }`, the import produces "innocent" but the constraint targets "arrow-core". Source-scoped rules (`from = "server/src/**"`) are bypassed because import and manifest signals use different name spaces.

3. **[medium] Project scan reads every file before filtering** (external.rs:411-418) — `walk_project_files` calls `read_to_string` on all non-directory entries before checking if the filename is Cargo.toml/pubspec.yaml. Should check filename first to avoid reading irrelevant files.
